checks.name: Backend verify incl. ConfigurationIntegrationTest and StaffAccessIntegrationTest (PostgreSQL)
Clean-clone workspace incl. contract lint/drift and registry parity

scenarios.observed: ConfigurationIntegrationTest: with an order placed at delivery fee 3000 and another quote outstanding, a zone fee change to 4500 (config.write with MFA; without MFA 403, config.read 403, stale version 409, negative fee 422; key sent percent-encoded) leaves the placed order at 3000, makes the stale quote fail with TOTAL_CHANGED and gives new quotes 4500; the change log lists it and is append-only; one audit event. A new synthetic policy version (tax 14%) makes a stale quote fail with POLICY_CHANGED while a new quote has tax 1820 and terms-v2; a real policy without approval reference is 422, with one it is active and approved; exactly one active policy; stale version 409; unknown key 404; future effectiveAt 422. The ordering switch off makes new quotes and placement 409 ORDERING_PAUSED while the cook can still accept a placed order; switched back on, quotes work. Mutations removing the approval guard or ignoring the switch failed.

StaffAccessIntegrationTest (backend verify): granting oneself a permission is refused (403, audited 'self-escalation refused'); revoking the last administrator grant is 409 (audited 'last administrator protected'); grant changes require recent MFA; revoked grants stop working on the next request; expired grants confer nothing. Operations web staff screen sends grants/revocations with reasons and shows the MFA step-up prompt.

Acceptance: configuration changes affect new quotes only (TC-042); self-escalation and loss of the last recoverable administrator prevented (TC-043); configuration audit append-only; live approval guard for real policies. Operations web component test: a zone change sends the new fee in piastres with reason and current version and shows the step-up link on STEP_UP_REQUIRED.

findings: Approval guard and ordering switch mutation-tested; new-quotes-only behaviour proven with placed and stale quotes.
Staff controls are MB-011 behaviour re-observed; UI added.
Residual: no scheduled changes; real policy values O04; configuration/staff UI not in the browser workflow.
